diagram_math_checks.justification: Enumerated all 24 S4 permutations using the prefix-rank criterion in lem-bruhat-order-basic-properties-for-permutations, then restricted to b<=x<=w and counted inversions; reproduces precisely step 1.1. Length increases upward in the figure.

Exhaustive prefix-rank comparisons with length difference one give exactly these sixteen edges, matching Verification 1.1 and the graded Bruhat property [F1]. No transitive edge b-w is drawn. Crossings have no vertex labels and the caption expressly says they are not vertices.

C=s2w=2413. Only b has a left s2 descent among these four vertices. Its length gap to C is two, so mu(b,C)=0 by the local mu convention [F3], making the correction sum empty as in step 2.1. Independent exact KL recursion gives P_id,C=P_b,C=1, hence P_b,w=1+q as in step 3.1.

Exact recursion on all 35 comparable interval pairs finds P_b,w=1+q as the sole nonconstant polynomial. By def-kazhdan-lusztig-polynomials-in-the-classical-q-normalization, mu is the coefficient of q^((4-1-1)/2)=q, hence one. The gap is three, so b<w is not a cover. These facts are shown as text below the Hasse edges, without a spurious cover line.
